fields: (a grid block, as: "route"): h, items [{t, d, link, spot, end, part}]. part: the plant stage(s) the stop checks, space-separated: panel, toc, pre, gen, tank, loop, uv, wear, report (no part: a caption without a stop). "end": true on the last item draws its stop as the sign-off tick and sets it as the closing line. The drawing is fixed (one PW package); the stops and captions come from the items.
best_for: VisitPlan shows a service visit as a route around the system on one navy drawing band: the whole PW plant in IsoKit line art, the technician's walk as a dashed route on the floor in front of it with a numbered stop at each part the visit checks, the checks as captions along the base of the band, and the signed report as one limestone line that closes it.
